pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

2. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

3. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.

4. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.

5. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

6. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.

7. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. happiness
   D. run

9. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

10. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.

11. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

12. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — went

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.

4. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.

5. D — One main idea with supporting sentences

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.

7. B — Where is the library?

8. D — run

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

10. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.

11. D — A person, place, thing, or idea

12. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Punctuation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pronunciation and Vocabulary; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
